mapper.sql: transfer_id, request_no, shop_user_id, source_system, phone, points, transfer_no, status, fail_code, fail_reason, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into shop_user_point_transfer (request_no, shop_user_id, source_system, phone, points, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{requestNo}, #{shopUserId}, #{sourceSystem}, #{phone}, #{points}, 'PENDING', sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select from shop_user_point_transfer where shop_user_id = #{shopUserId} and source_system = #{sourceSystem} and status = 'PENDING' order by transfer_id desc limit 1
select from shop_user_point_transfer where status = 'PENDING' order by transfer_id
select from shop_user_point_transfer where request_no = #{requestNo} limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update shop_user_point_transfer set status = 'SUCCESS', transfer_no = #{transferNo}, update_time = sysdate() where request_no = #{requestNo} and status = 'PENDING'
update shop_user_point_transfer set status = 'FAILED', fail_code = #{failCode}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = sysdate() where request_no = #{requestNo} and status = 'PENDING'
